starter: An oval, single-celled body that grows to a tiny size, with 2 whips.
It swims at a steady pace and turns easily.
It eats a little of everything.
Its skin is weak and tears easily.
Rarity: common, with nothing that stands out.
armoured: A round, single-celled body that grows to a tiny size, with 2 paddles.
It swims slowly and turns slowly.
It eats a little of everything.
Heavy plates cover its body, and spines bristle outwards.
Rarity: common, with nothing that stands out.
hunter: A round, single-celled body that grows to a tiny size, with 2 whips and 2 hooks.
It swims at a steady pace and turns sharply.
It bites crystals with its jaws.
Its skin is weak and tears easily.
Rarity: rare, thanks to its extra limbs.
